rationales.authenticity: Period-appropriate midwife knowledge; 'aforehand', 'pains coming close and steady' reflect 1820 birth practice.
rationales.character: Experienced midwife with knowing tone about childbirth signs; authoritative and reassuring.
rationales.craft: Three sentences, concise and specific; the practical wisdom and eye contact direction add evocative character.
rationales.language: Well-formed English with Irish dialect and vocabulary; clean and natural pacing.
rationales.responsiveness: Directly and thoroughly addresses when to fetch the midwife for labor.
